note: The wait_time_anomaly alert EXACTLY as it shipped before ruling D2(b), extracted from git at the lane's base commit - not hand-written. An install upgraded from any build at or before this SHA has this object in its Config/alert-definitions.json, because the installer ships that file onlyifdoesntexist. The migrator tests splice this into a copy of the CURRENT shipped catalogue to make a realistic upgraded-install file.

alert.name: Wait Time Anomaly
alert.description: Wait time accrued per second across all sessions, measured as the change in cumulative total wait time between two samples, is abnormally high compared to typical workload
alert.query: SELECT SUM(wait_time_ms) AS value FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats WHERE wait_type NOT IN ('SLEEP_TASK','LAZYWRITER_SLEEP','SQLTRACE_BUFFER_FLUSH','CLR_AUTO_EVENT','CLR_SEMAPHORE','BROKER_EVENTHANDLER','BROKER_RECEIVE_WAITFOR','BROKER_TASK_STOP','BROKER_TO_FLUSH','CHECKPOINT_QUEUE','DBMIRROR_DBM_EVENT','DBMIRRORING_CMD','DIRTY_PAGE_POLL','DISPATCHER_QUEUE_SEMAPHORE','FT_IFTS_SCHEDULER_IDLE_WAIT','HADR_FILESTREAM_IOMGR_IOCOMPLETION','HADR_WORK_QUEUE','LOGMGR_QUEUE','ONDEMAND_TASK_QUEUE','REQUEST_FOR_DEADLOCK_SEARCH','RESOURCE_QUEUE','SERVER_IDLE_CHECK','SP_SERVER_DIAGNOSTICS_SLEEP','SQLTRACE_INCREMENTAL_FLUSH_SLEEP','TRACEWRITE','WAIT_XTP_HOST_WAIT','WAITFOR','XE_DISPATCHER_WAIT','XE_TIMER_EVENT')
